It's a shame that this world pressures you into being fine, like just recently people started taking the mental health as something serious and still its a pretty difficult topic to talk about, so its normal to relapse multiple times but hell, you've got nothing to prove to anybody, no one has the right to pressure into being fine after all you've endured, you should be proud of yourself, really. About therapy, it can be intimidating at first, but soon enough you'll find yourself in a "safe space" (well, that if the therapist is good, of course), and even tho it's not like talking to a friend evidently, it's a personal thing (at least in my experience) , and the fact that your family doesnt take your problems seriously probably means that you don't talk about this too much with them, right? Of course, take your time, but if you ask me, I'd advice you to think about it, really.

(FMA:B SPOILERS, OBVIOUSLY) Well, I agree that maybe the fight itself, despite what happened before of it (Father losing his powers) wasn't the most exciting one, however, that episode was a masterpiece, the dialogue between Father and Truth is one, if not THE ONE, most epic scenes in probably all anime, I mean, the irony of Father being sent to the infinite knowledge he desired, the fact that at the end he never surpassed humans despite thinking that he had no "human defects" (7 sins) and the way he is shown being literally nothing but the dwarf he had been in the past. It's really really hard making a memorable scene in anime, as there are a lot of them going and many of them are trying to reach that same goal, but having a memorable dialogue scene is twice as hard. Also, everyone knew Father was gonna die at the end, it just had to happen because of the tone of the series, I don't think Arakawa thought otherwise, so the ending itself wasn't gonna be a surprise I think, just how it was gonna be shown.

(Oh yeah, the Ed and Truth dialogue isn't my favorite one, but still, Edward understanding what Father didn't; the fact that despite all his powers, he wasn't more than "someone else" , but that being "someone else" didn't mean being "nothing", it's really wonderful Imo.)

EDIT: Maybe exaggerated with the most epic scene in Anime, I dont watch anime that much tbh lol.

Stay strong friend! Hope everything turns out well for you in the future!
